{"metadata":{"description":"DSH Session Manager: manage conversations, archive/restore, delete safely, open record folders.","id":"gh:1333993082","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-archived-sessions","slug":"Zephyr-vibe/dsh-archived-sessions","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","deepseek-harness-plugins","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins","plugin","plugins","session-manager"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH Session Manager: manage conversations, archive/restore, delete safely, open record folders."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-archived-sessions（DSH 会话管理）"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"一个 DSH Web 插件：在「设置」中提供**会话管理**，统一管理本机上的所有对话。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"English"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### 功能"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **双标签页**：**所有对话**（未归档）与**归档会话**
- **视图切换**：**单列表**或**按工作区分组**（无工作区归属的会话兜底归入「未分组」）
- 按标题 + 相对时间浏览对话"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"，最近的排在最前
- **搜索框**：按标题或 ID 实时过滤会话列表
- 勾选 / 拖动批量勾选 / 全选 / 批量**归档**（记录保留）/ 批量**删除**（永久删除，带确认弹窗）
- **「删"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"除会话」入口已移至会话头部**（适配 DSH 0.1.0-rc.8）：rc.8 起官方侧边栏行菜单（⋮）不再开放插件注入点（只剩 重命名/分叉/归档），删除按钮改放在**打开的会话标题栏**（🗑 垃圾"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"桶图标）——确认弹窗可细粒度勾选删除其下**子对话 / 下载·产出文件 / 整个文件夹**，默认只删会话本身
- 归档页支持**移出归档**（回到所有对话）
- **打开记录文件夹**按钮：在系统文件"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"管理器中打开所选会话的记录目录，跨平台（`explorer` / `open` / `xdg-open`）
- 每行可展开详情（默认收起）：占用空间、最后更新、活动统计（轮次、步骤、消息数、工具调用分"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"布、fetch 记录）、产出/下载文件、父会话与子会话（分叉）
- **子代理会话**嵌套显示在父会话下方（缩进 + 「子代理」徽标）；父会话被删除或缺失时自动浮出为顶层行
- **删除父会话不会级联"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"**：子代理、分叉、下载/产出文件均保留，除非你显式勾选它们——避免误删
- 当前打开的会话显示「当前会话」徽标，且**不可删除**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 截图"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"归档会话视图 / 子代理会话嵌套在父会话下"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"详情面板（含活动统计、产出文件、关联对话）"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"会话头部「删除会话」入口（rc.8 起删除入口移至会话头部）"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"删除确认弹窗——可勾选删除其下子对话 / 下载·产出文件 / 整个文件夹"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 安装"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"#### 方式一：直接 tarball 安装"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"如果 pnpm 拦截构建脚本，在命令末尾加 `--ignore-scripts`："},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"#### 方式二：让 agent 安装"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"告诉你的 DSH 智能体："},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"agent 会下载项目、放入 profile 的 `node_modules` 并注册到 `dsh.profile.bundles`。"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"安装后重启 web 端，即可在「设置」中看到「会话管理」入口。"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### 兼容性"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **零配置**：会话目录按官方 DSH 布局（`$DSH_HOME/sessions/<project-key>/<session-id>/`）自动识别，无需核心补丁
- **归档 / 恢复**："},{"id":"p25s2","text":"基于官方 `archiveSession` 相同的 `registry` 状态原语实现
- **删除不级联**：只删除所选会话，子代理、分叉与文件均保留；运行中的会话拒绝删除（409）
- **API"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" 仅信任本机请求**（127.0.0.1 / localhost / ::1）；仅使用官方公开 API（`workspaceRegistry`、`sessionPersistence`）"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### 更新日志"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"#### 0.1.5"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"> **背景：适配 DSH 核心 0.1.0-rc.8 更新。** rc.8 移除了官方 `workspaceRegistry.deleteSession` 与 `sessionPersistence"},{"id":"p28s2","text":".remove`，官方侧边栏会话行菜单（⋮）也只保留 重命名/分叉/归档 且不再开放插件注入点——本版本针对这些变化重做删除链路、补回删除入口，并修复升级过程中暴露的若干问题。"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **修复：删除后 live 会话残留（核心 rc.8 兼容）**——rc.8 移除官方删除原语后，旧版删除只做工作区 detach + 磁盘清理，会漏掉仍挂在 sessions store 里的 "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"live 会话：删除后它依旧出现在列表，且因工作区已 detach 而落入「未分组」（重启后才会消失）；现在删除前先 flush 全部目标会话日志，删除后用官方公开原语 `SessionStore.l"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"iveEntryFor + detachEntered` 摘除 live 会话（广播 `session/disposed`，持久化状态同步清理），并保持 0.1.3 的「只删自己 / 不级联」语义不变"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"or + detachEntered` 摘除 live 会话（广播 `session/disposed`，持久化状态同步清理），并保持 0.1.3 的「只删自己 / 不级联」语义不变
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Features"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Two tabs**: **All conversations** (non-archived) and **Archived**
- **View modes**: **flat list*"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"* or **grouped by workspace** (sessions without a workspace fall back to "Ungrouped")
- Browse conve"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"rsations by title + relative time, newest first
- **Search box**: filter the session list by title o"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"r id in real time
- Checkbox / drag-to-select / select-all / batch **archive** (records kept) / batc"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"h **delete** (permanent, with a confirmation modal)
- **The "Delete session" entry moved to the sess"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"ion header** (adapted for DSH 0.1.0-rc.8): since rc.8 the official sidebar row menu (⋮) no longer ex"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"poses a plugin injection point (only Rename / Fork / Archive remain), so the delete button now lives"},{"id":"p31s8","text":" in the **opened session's title bar** (🗑 trash icon) — its confirmation dialog lets you optionally "},{"id":"p31s9","text":"delete this session's **sub-conversations / downloaded·produced files / whole folders**, with nothin"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"g checked by default (only the session itself)
- **Unarchive** from the Archived tab (move back to A"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"ll conversations)
- **Open record folder** button: opens the selected session's record directory in "},{"id":"p31s12","text":"your OS file manager — cross-platform via `explorer` / `open` / `xdg-open`
- Expand each row for det"},{"id":"p31s13","text":"ails (collapsed by default): size on disk, last update, activity stats (turns, steps, messages, tool"},{"id":"p31s14","text":"-call distribution, fetch history), produced/downloaded files, parent and child (fork) sessions
- **"},{"id":"p31s15","text":"Subagent sessions** are shown nested under their parent conversation (indented, with a "subagent" ba"},{"id":"p31s16","text":"dge); when the parent is deleted or missing they surface as top-level rows
- **Deleting a parent ses"},{"id":"p31s17","text":"sion does NOT cascade**: subagent children, forks, and downloaded/produced files are kept unless you"},{"id":"p31s18","text":" explicitly select them — nothing is lost accidentally
- The currently open session shows a **Curren"},{"id":"p31s19","text":"t** badge and **cannot be deleted**"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"### Compatibility"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **Zero config**: session directories are auto-detected from the official DSH layout (`$DSH_HOME/se"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ssions/<project-key>/<session-id>/`) — no core patches
- **Archive / unarchive**: built on the same "},{"id":"p33s3","text":"`registry` state primitives as the official `archiveSession`
- **Non-cascading delete**: only the se"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"lected session is removed; subagents, forks and files are kept; running sessions are rejected (409)
"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"- **Loopback-only API** (127.0.0.1 / localhost / ::1); official public APIs only (`workspaceRegistry"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"`, `sessionPersistence`)"}],"truncated":true}
